scope: Six experiments; Ink implementation plus tested gdev/Pen patches. Sibling worktrees were not edited.

compiler.note: Frozen after the installed compiler changed during the investigation.

dispositions.name: array copying
dispositions.change: Read the immutable restitution flag from imp_in; bulk-initialize spatial bounds. Static allocation remarks identify the old escaped edit; they are not executed allocation counts.

dispositions.name: packed ECS
dispositions.change: Both padded and dense pages preserved witnesses but failed to improve whole-game CPU consistently; dense pages were 6–9% slower against original storage in the paired ablation. Original ECS retained. Dense experiment preserved as a patch.

dispositions.name: exact point index
dispositions.change: Caller-owned x/z point BVH with source-index ties and eligibility; staged game rebuilds only for changed positions or membership, including mid-crew removals.

dispositions.name: retained rendering
dispositions.result: kept as opt-in library adapter and sibling patches
dispositions.change: Caller-owned group identities; matching transactional Pen instance cache and sparse uploads. Ordinary host keeps its existing bindings contract.

dispositions.name: SIMD acceleration
dispositions.change: Size/compiler-context-dependent results, including small-workload regressions. Scalar implementation kept; explicit vector experiment and bitwise tests preserved.

dispositions.name: CPU workers
dispositions.result: optional native implementation and planning prototype
dispositions.change: Bounded numeric packets, fresh isolated guests, ordered synchronous joins. Coarse route forecasts tested; normal game actor ticks are not dispatched to workers. Browser callback unsupported.

nativeGame.clock: Linux CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID around guest entry and callback result copying; packet resolution, compilation, asset preparation and saves excluded.
nativeGame.limitations: CPU frequency and cache contention still vary. Fixed saved world and idle inputs; not a reproduction of every live-session spike. Three alternating pairs, no renderer in timed calls.

ablationVariants.retained: padded ECS, indexed piles, retained draws, SIMD acceleration
ablationVariants.dense: dense ECS, indexed piles, retained draws, SIMD acceleration
ablationVariants.no-packed: original ECS, indexed piles, retained draws, SIMD acceleration
ablationVariants.no-index: padded ECS, original pile search, retained draws, SIMD acceleration
ablationVariants.no-retained: padded ECS, indexed piles, immediate draws, SIMD acceleration

renderWitness.comparison: Every resolved frame lane compared bitwise after canonical draw ordering and pose-index remapping. Same result after final host-wrapper fix.
renderWitness.pixelMethod: Sequential software Vulkan renders of frames 0, 60 and 119; final image compared bytewise. This is correctness evidence, not hardware GPU timing.

restitutionAndSimd.host: Pen blot-host / Wasmtime; includes inputs and output copying

workers.includes: input geometry encoding, guest batch transport, cold pool and instances, ordered results, output decoding, pool shutdown; compiled module excluded
